ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are five congruent equilateral triangles, all located above the same horizontal straight line, and one side of each triangle lies on this horizontal line. Each two adjacent triangles are staggered along the horizontal line by half a base length, so there is a small equilateral triangle overlap region between adjacent triangles; triangles separated by more than one triangle at most meet at boundary points, with no positive-area overlap. Reasoning: Let the side length of each equilateral triangle be s = 2√3. The area of a single equilateral triangle is (√3/4)s^2 = (√3/4)(2√3)^2 = (√3/4)·12 = 3√3. The total area of the five triangles is 5·3√3 = 15√3. The horizontal displacement of two adjacent triangles is half a side length, so their overlapping part is an equilateral triangle with side length s/2 = √3. The area of each overlap region is (√3/4)(√3)^2 = 3√3/4. There are 4 pairs of adjacent triangles that produce such overlaps, and there is no positive-area triple overlap. Therefore the union area is 15√3 - 4·(3√3/4) = 15√3 - 3√3 = 12√3.

raw_record.question_text: Five equilateral triangles, each with side $2\sqrt{3}$, are arranged so they are all on the same side of a line containing one side of each. Along this line, the midpoint of the base of one triangle is a vertex of the next. What is the area of the region of the plane covered by the union of the five triangular regions?

method.method_draft: First inspect the diagram: it shows five congruent upright equilateral triangles above the same horizontal baseline, with each consecutive triangle shifted horizontally by half a base length, so only neighboring triangles overlap in small triangular regions; non-neighboring triangles meet at most along boundary points. From the text, take the side length as s = 2√3 and the condition that a midpoint of one base is a vertex of the next, confirming the half-side shift. Compute the area of one equilateral triangle as (√3/4)s^2 = 3√3, so five separate triangles would have area 15√3. For each adjacent pair, the overlap is an equilateral triangle with side s/2 = √3, hence overlap area (√3/4)(√3)^2 = 3√3/4. There are four adjacent overlaps and no positive-area triple overlaps, so by inclusion-exclusion the union area is 5(3√3) - 4(3√3/4) = 12√3.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有五个全等的等边三角形，全部位于同一条水平直线的上方，每个三角形的一条边都落在这条水平线上。相邻两个三角形沿水平线错开半个底边长度，因此相邻三角形之间有一个小的等边三角形重叠区域；隔一个以上的三角形至多在边界点相接，没有正面积重叠。

推理：设每个等边三角形边长为 s = 2√3。单个等边三角形面积为 (√3/4)s^2 = (√3/4)(2√3)^2 = (√3/4)·12 = 3√3。五个三角形面积总和为 5·3√3 = 15√3。

相邻两个三角形的水平错位是半个边长，所以它们的重叠部分是边长 s/2 = √3 的等边三角形。每个重叠区域面积为 (√3/4)(√3)^2 = 3√3/4。共有 4 对相邻三角形产生这样的重叠，并且没有正面积的三重重叠。

因此并集面积为 15√3 - 4·(3√3/4) = 15√3 - 3√3 = 12√3。
